# Terms of Use

Ping AI shows short AI-generated tips and quiz questions on topics you choose, in a widget, in notifications and inside the app. By using the app you accept these terms.

AI content can be wrong, outdated or incomplete. Ping AI is for learning and curiosity, not professional advice (legal, medical, financial, safety or other). Check official sources before relying on it.

The app needs an API key from an AI provider (Google Gemini by default; OpenAI or Anthropic in Pro). You obtain and control the key, and you are responsible for keeping it secret and for your provider's limits and charges. Free-tier limits are set by the provider and can change.

Pro unlocks extra features. For now it is activated with a code and no payment is processed in the app. If paid billing is added, separate purchase terms will apply.

The free version shows ads from Google AdMob. Rewarded ads are optional and give extra questions. Please do not click ads artificially. Pro has no ads.

Do not misuse the app: no reverse engineering to bypass limits, no automated abuse of AI providers, and no use that breaks your provider's terms. You are responsible for what you share.

The app is provided as is, without warranty. To the extent the law allows, the developer is not liable for indirect damages, lost data, provider charges or decisions based on AI content. Nothing here limits rights you have under your local consumer law. We may update the app and these terms; continued use means you accept them.

# Privacy Policy

Ping AI has no accounts and no developer server. Your topics, tips, saved items, statistics, settings and API keys stay on your phone (keys in encrypted storage when supported). App backup is off. Uninstalling deletes this data.

When a tip or explanation is requested, the app sends your API key, the topic text you typed, the chosen language, a few recent tip titles and your like and dislike hints (to avoid repeats) to the AI provider you selected. It does not send your name, e-mail, contacts, location or files. The provider handles this under its own terms; for example, content sent on Google's free Gemini tier may be used to improve Google products. Do not type personal or confidential information as a topic.

Anonymous usage statistics (Firebase Analytics, by Google) record events such as the topic category, how many questions were shown, answered correctly or wrongly, details opened, shares, ads watched, the app and content language, and the device and app version. Your free-text topic is never sent; it only counts as "custom". You can turn this off any time in Settings, under Privacy & ads.

In the free version Google AdMob may use device identifiers such as the advertising ID and your IP address to show and measure ads, under Google's policies. You can reset your advertising ID or limit personalization in Android settings. Where required, a consent form is shown.

Builds installed outside Google Play may contact GitHub to check for a newer version; GitHub can see your IP address like any website.

Permissions: internet (AI providers, ads, update check), notifications (tips), vibration (answer feedback) and start at boot (restore scheduling). Quiet hours are on by default.

The developer does not sell your data. Ping AI is not directed to children under 13; younger users should use it only with a parent or guardian. For questions or requests, open an issue at github.com/CptPureBlood/Communityworks. Requests about data held by an AI provider or ad network must go to them.
